area_corrections:
1) State handling for the shared helpers. J2DScreen::draw with a non-NULL context never calls setPort (J2DScreen.cpp:149-153). Callers call graf->setPort() first. J2DFillBox and J2DDrawLine build a default J2DOrthoGraph that only loads an identity pos matrix (J2DOrthoGraph.cpp:12-15, 59-77), so they draw in whatever projection is live. ws_screen_draw_full must therefore call J2DOrthoGraph::setPort (0x802CDCB4) after writing mOrtho (+0xBC..+0xCB; mNear/mFar at +0xCC/+0xD0 are left alone, keeping the per-phase near/far) and again after restoring. Side fills drawn right after a normal J2DScreen::draw are in compressed units.
2) Gecko's `li r4,0` is not 'the vanilla ortho'. The NULL path builds J2DOrthoGraph(0,0,640,480), whose ortho box is 0..640 x 0..480, not -9..650 x -21..503 (J2DScreen.cpp:154-158, J2DOrthoGraph.cpp:18-24). That is a ~3% scale/offset versus vanilla, so restoring the real vanilla box (as ws_screen_draw_full does) is more faithful.
3) Root vs child panes. Only a root pane rebuilds its matrix from mBounds every draw (J2DPane.cpp:180-183). Children are placed by mMtx from calcMtx/move. Direct mBounds writes are valid only on screen roots (placename). For children, edit the fopMsgM pane class Orig fields and paneTrans/cposMove (f_op_msg_mng.cpp:9850-9888), or call J2DPane::move/resize.
4) The private-ortho draws in this area restore state (pictureDraw at d_picture_box.cpp:710-712/778-781, ClearAlphaBuffer re-sets the 3D projection, THP has its own setup/restore), so there is no compressed/uncompressed state leak.
5) The blo dumps in scratch-menus/blo-dump-allmsg.txt settle the layouts the finder left open: wipe_01_01/02 (picto), wipe_00/_2 (scope), gameover, opening, operate_wind_mask, auction1/2. The auction screen has a top-left bid display (see corrected item).
6) The hook count rises by about one: the auction screenSet hook. The scope fix needs pane-edge reads instead of constants.
